OpenSL ES public headers from AOSP `frameworks/wilhelm`, used to type-check
guest interface tables and native ABI regression tests. Original license
notices are retained in each header.

Source: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/wilhelm/+/refs/heads/master/include/SLES/

Interface UUID reference: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/wilhelm/+/refs/heads/master/src/OpenSLES_IID.cpp
